national_news.title: Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Flagged Off; Northern Bullet Train Corridor Approved
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and UP CM Yogi Adityanath flagged off the first Vande Bharat Sleeper Express connecting Varanasi and New Delhi.
The Prime Minister approved the Northern Corridor bullet train network connecting Delhi to Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Patna, and Guwahati.
Construction is underway for Namo Setu in Varanasi, a combined rail-cum-road bridge featuring a six-lane highway on the upper deck and four railway tracks on the lower deck.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Tourism & Infrastructure Projects at Ekta Nagar on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas
bullets: PM Narendra Modi visited Ekta Nagar in Gujarat to mark the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas.
Projects worth over ₹426 crore were inaugurated or assigned foundation stones, including 23 completed tourism and infrastructure projects worth ₹307 crore.
Key inaugurated projects include a 12-acre artificial Rain Forest with a circular glass skywalk, Vaman Vriksha Vatika, Ekta Cruise, an IRCTC hotel, and an Eco Trail.

national_news.title: SEBI Unveils AI Tool 'Sudarshan' and New Measures to Curb Financial Fraud
bullets: SEBI announced the development of an AI-based tool named 'Sudarshan' utilizing a five-stage checking process to detect financial fraud and suspicious activities on social media.
SEBI partnered with Google for Play Store verified badges on official financial apps and launched the SCORES 2.0 portal alongside the SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facility.
A multi-lingual investor awareness WhatsApp channel in 11 languages and the 'Samajh ke Investing Simple' regional campaign were rolled out to enhance investor protection.

national_news.title: Government Constitutes High-Level Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat 2047
bullets: The Finance Ministry constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel.
The committee includes RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan as members, with a six-month tenure.
It will recommend structural, regulatory, and legal reforms for banks including RRBs and Cooperative Banks, alongside drafting a roadmap for AI adoption and cyber security.

national_news.title: EAM Advocates Diplomacy over Military Solutions at G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar addressed the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, USA, stressing adherence to UNCLOS and freedom of navigation.
He highlighted that attacks on civilian shipping severely impact Global South nations by escalating prices of essential commodities like fuel, food, and fertilizers.
The Minister will also attend the QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta and lead India's delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in Antigua and Barbuda.

national_news.title: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Navigation Satellite Onboard GSLV-F18
bullets: ISRO launched the 2,232 kg NVS-03 satellite aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, placing it in Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit.
NVS-03 is the third satellite in the second-generation NavIC constellation, featuring an indigenous atomic clock and introducing the L1 frequency band alongside L5 and S bands.
The mission marked the 20th flight of the GSLV and set a record turnaround time of just 56 days between successive GSLV missions.

national_news.title: EPFO Celebrates 74th Foundation Day; Launches Key Member-Centric Initiatives
bullets: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) observed its 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi, presided over by Union Minister for Labour & Employment Mansukh Mandaviya.
Key digital initiatives were launched, including the automatic settlement of eligible inoperative EPF accounts with balances up to Rs 1,000 and EPFO service delivery through WhatsApp.
The event also featured the distribution of the Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 to recognize top-performing regional and zonal offices.

national_news.title: SEBI Relaxes KYC Review Rules for Foreign Portfolio Investors
bullets: SEBI increased the periodicity of KYC reviews for Category-One FPIs from non-high-risk jurisdictions and certain high-risk entities to once every eight years.
The compliance burden was reduced by dispensing with the requirement for FPIs to intimate changes or submit no-change declarations during registration continuity.
FPIs continuing registration for a subsequent three-year block only need to pay required fees to their Designated Depository Participants 15 days prior to expiry.
The new provisions will come into force with effect from 1st December.

national_news.title: PM Modi Launches Development Projects Worth Rs 14,000 Crore in Gujarat and Releases PM-KISAN Installment
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for development projects worth over Rs 14,000 crore in Banaskantha and Ekta Nagar, Gujarat.
Released the 24th installment under the PM-KISAN scheme, amounting to Rs 19,000 crore.
Laid the foundation stones for Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A (Airport Extension) and Phase-2B (GIFT City Extension).
Visited the Embryo Transfer Technology-In Vitro Fertilisation Laboratory and Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre to boost genetic upgradation.

national_news.title: 14th International Tourism Mart Inaugurated in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: The 14th edition of the International Tourism Mart (ITM) was inaugurated in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, organized by the Ministry of Tourism in association with North Eastern States.
The three-day event (October 29-31) aims to showcase the tourism potential, biodiversity, and cultural heritage of the eight North Eastern states.
Union Minister for Tourism and Culture Gajendra Singh Shekhawat highlighted the focus on adventure tourism, music festivals, and improving regional connectivity.

national_news.title: India Post and UTI Mutual Fund Extend Partnership for Doorstep KYC Verification
bullets: India Post and UTI Mutual Fund extended their partnership to expand doorstep Know Your Customer (KYC) verification services across India under the Pan-India KYC Verification Project.
The initiative aims to leverage India Post's extensive last-mile connectivity to enhance financial inclusion and simplify investor verification in remote and underserved areas.
The MoU was signed by Adnan Ahmed (Chief General Manager, Parcel & CCS Directorate, Department of Posts) and Vetri Subramaniam (MD and CEO, UTI AMC) in Mumbai.

bihar_news.title: ISRO to Set Up Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium
bullets: ISRO experts inspected the site for a Space Gallery and Space Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium in Bihar to boost STEM education in the Mithila region.
The project covers two acres at an estimated cost of ₹61 crore, with technical support assured by Space Commission Chairman V. Narayanan.
The centre will showcase ISRO missions like Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Aditya-L1, and Gaganyaan through 3D/VR models and offer hands-on training in robotics and rocketry.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th Globally and 1st in Asia by German Travel Guide
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum secured the 9th rank in the list of the world's 100 best museums for 2026 released by German travel publication 'Worth a Journey'.
It became the highest-ranked museum in Asia, placed ahead of New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art (10th) and Paris's Musée du Louvre.
Mexico City's Museo Nacional de Antropología topped the global ranking of museums.

bihar_news.title: Architectural and Artifact Highlights of Bihar Museum
bullets: Bihar Museum was designed by Japan's Maki and Associates in collaboration with Mumbai-based Opolis, using weathering-steel, terracotta, and local stone.
The museum houses the iconic 5-foot 2-inch Didarganj Yakshi, a polished Chunar sandstone sculpture discovered in Patna in 1917.
Its chronological history galleries cover major regional empires including the Mauryas, Sungas, Kushanas, Guptas, and Palas.

bihar_news.title: BIRSAC Signs MoU with Survey of India for Geospatial Collaboration in Bihar
bullets: The Bihar Remote Sensing Application Centre (BIRSAC) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Survey of India (SOI) in Patna during the Space Application Adoption Workshop 2026.
The agreement enables technical collaboration in geospatial data sharing, capacity building, and joint projects to aid urban planning and disaster management in Bihar.
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary attended the event and launched the 'TechConnect' portal to integrate space-based technology into state governance.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Directs Education Department Officers to Integrate AI into Administrative Work
bullets: Bihar's Education Department issued an advisory to District Education Officers (DEOs) encouraging officials to adopt generative AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude for drafting letters and monitoring state schemes.
The state IT Department is procuring enterprise licences for ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot to distribute among departments.
Staff capacity building will be conducted using the Central Government's iGOT online learning portal, supported by a nodal AI framework set up across departments.

bihar_news.title: HPCL to Set Up ₹159-Crore Compressed Biogas Plant in Bhagalpur, Bihar
bullets: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) plans to construct a ₹159 crore Compressed Biogas (CBG) plant at Kankaithi in Bhagalpur, Bihar.
The plant will process 135 tonnes of segregated municipal wet waste per day to generate green fuel (CBG) and organic agricultural manure.
Bhagalpur Municipal Corporation will provide 10 acres of land free of cost for 25 years, after which the operational facility will be transferred to the civic body.

bihar_news.title: IAS Officer Sandeep Poundrik Appointed as Secretary of Ministry of Heavy Industries
bullets: 1993-batch Bihar cadre IAS officer Sandeep Poundrik has been given the additional charge of the Ministry of Heavy Industries, while continuing as Secretary of the Steel Ministry.

The Heavy Industries Ministry oversees key schemes including the ₹25,938-crore PLI Scheme for Automobiles and Auto Parts, the ₹11,900-crore PM E-Drive scheme, and the ₹18,100-crore PLI scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cells.
The ministry also manages a ₹7,280-crore incentive package launched in November 2025 to set up five rare-earth magnet-making plants to counter global shortages.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Documentary 'Mothers of Courage' Wins UN SDG Action Award 2026
bullets: 'Mothers of Courage', a documentary on a grassroots women-led movement for girls' education in Bihar, won the 2026 UN SDG Action Award in the Creativity category.
The film is a part of 'Shikshagraha', a public education movement championed by Infosys co-founder S.D. Shibulal and supported by non-profits ShikshaLokam and Mantra4Change.
The initiative has mobilized over 1.19 million citizens across 14 districts in Bihar through village-level community gatherings known as 'Shiksha Chaupals'.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Transport Department Takes Action on Low Revenue Districts
bullets: Bihar Transport Minister Damodar Raut issued show-cause notices to over 10 District Transport Officers (DTOs) for revenue collection falling below 40% of assigned targets in districts like Munger, Kaimur, and Saran.
Body-worn cameras were directed to be provided to Enforcement Sub-Inspectors at key checkposts including Nawada, Kaimur, Gaya, and Gopalganj to enhance transparency.
Officials were instructed to spread awareness about the Pradhan Mantri Rahat Yojana and Ayushman Bharat scheme to assist road accident victims.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves ₹37.10 Crore for Greenfield Road Corridors under PPP Model
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved ₹37.10 crore for transaction-adviser consultancy services to develop Vishwamitra Path, Ganga Ambika Path, and Narayani Path under the PPP model.
The three four-lane greenfield corridors span a combined length of approximately 220 km along the Ganga and Gandak river regions, implemented via BSRDCL.
The cabinet also approved land transfers to the Ministry of Railways for the construction of the new Supaul–Araria railway line.

bihar_news.title: BCECEB Releases PGMAC 2026 Degree Rank Card
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) activated the rank card portal for PGMAC 2026 (Degree) for state-quota postgraduate medical counselling.
Registered candidates can check their merit rank for MD, MS, and DNB broad-speciality seats using their PGMAC ID and date of birth.
The rank is computed based on NEET-PG 2026 scores, category reservations, and state rules.

bihar_news.title: India's Central Sector Infrastructure Pipeline Reaches Rs 37.56 Lakh Crore
bullets: India's infrastructure pipeline reached ₹37.56 lakh crore across 1,853 ongoing Central Sector projects as of September 2026.
Transport & Logistics holds the highest investment share at ₹20.07 lakh crore, followed by Energy at ₹11.04 lakh crore.
Major ongoing projects include the Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar worth ₹13,756.56 crore commissioned in September 2026.

bihar_news.title: Bihar MBA Graduate Empowers Local Families as Entrepreneur Under PMEGP
bullets: An MBA graduate from Purnia district, Satyam Sundaram, successfully established a bamboo-based products enterprise utilizing financial assistance under the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP).
He availed a loan of Rs 10 lakh through the Central government's PMEGP scheme to launch his venture named 'Manipuri Bamboo Architecture'.
The enterprise has successfully created sustainable livelihoods and employment opportunities for nearly 40 families in his native village.

bihar_news.title: NABARD Backs Bihar's Sone River Drinking Water Infrastructure Project with Rs 1,774 Crore
bullets: A total investment of Rs 2,014 crore has been cleared for a drinking water scheme in Aurangabad, Sasaram, and Dehri, supported by NABARD's Rs 1,774 crore backing.
The project will draw surface water from the Sone river to reinforce and expand the existing drinking water supply systems in the three urban centers.
The initiative falls under broader state efforts to improve basic infrastructure and aligns with the objectives of Bihar's Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali campaign.
